description: H2-Stations is an access point for data on hydrogen refuelling stations (HRS) across Europe, described on the Clean Hydrogen Partnership site. It provides free and open access to both static and dynamic HRS data at European level through a European HRS availability map with real-time location and availability status, a portal with dashboards for operators, national bodies and signal originators who provide and monitor data, and supporting documentation and guidance. The platform also helps operators and national bodies meet reporting obligations under the Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR), and user feedback is encouraged. It is delivered by Spilett New Technologies with ERM and EMCEL for the Partnership. Coverage is Europe. Access: the platform at h2-stations.eu, free; the Partnership page states no licence and the platform pages were not read, so data formats and download routes are unverified. It suits hydrogen infrastructure planning and monitoring, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
